gate: Frozen P0-C mixed-L 17D LR; no Gate retraining
training: Same 17-128-64-1 sigmoid MSE ET architecture/optimizer as original. Train unpruned control and pooled Gate-trajectory ET with query-level inner holdout; early stop then refit all training queries. Inputs contain only 17 live features; Gate threshold and future outcomes are not inputs.
label: Actual GT Recall@10 of exact-scored prefix; final Gate-only recall recorded for diagnosis, not substituted for absolute quality.
tuning: Full Cartesian L x Gate threshold x ET threshold for each joint family; ET-only uses all ET thresholds; baseline uses existing 64 L. Greater tuning budget for joint families is explicit. Select on validation only, freeze before any test. Test only locked configurations plus their fixed-parameter disable-Gate / disable-ET controls; 3 repeats.
timing: Native search, feature extraction, inference and I/O included; load and 128-query warmup excluded. Sequential workloads. Interleave model/family batches.
limits: Previously observed benchmark queries; exploratory, not a new confirmatory sample
Finite grid, joint search has more configurations than single strategies
WSL2 guest O_DIRECT/block read traffic, not NAND telemetry
Only LR Gate evaluated; MLP Gate adaptation remains outside this run
No promise that average-recall validation constraint transfers to test
